reason: My helper does a lot of the cooking and shops with her own habits, so I'm not going to be scanning receipts. I already track calories in another app and I don't want a second one to maintain.
objection: My helper manages the kitchen, not an app. Getting her to scan receipts and use a shared list is more work than it saves, and nutrition is behind the paid plan anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Nutrition and protein tracking for the recipes free, and proof that a helper can use it easily in Arabic without me managing it.
